title: Main Kalla Reh Gaya Akber Mera Jag Tey Reya Koi Nai
body:
Tenu Keway Uthawan May Mera Ghazi Bhera Koi Nai
<<DIVIDER>>
Kisi Zalim Nay Enjh Barchi Teray Seenay Tey Chori Ay
Beghan e Mulk Day Andar Qammar Babay Di Tori Ay
Jithay Jhaneya Ay Tu Bachra Menu Labhi Ooh Jaan Koi Nai
<<DIVIDER>>
Jay Bachri Teri Kad Dewan Teray Saawan Nay Muk Jana
Teri Vichri Howi Sughra Day Armana Nay Mukh Jaana
Tu Lahazay Da Parona Ay Teray Ghum Da Waassa Koi Nai
<<DIVIDER>>
Teri Hamsheer Da Qasid Wattan Ton Laal Aya Ay
Tenu Khat Likh Kay Vichri Nay Madinay Vich Bulaya Ay
Main Onu Kiway Likh Dewan Tera Veeran Reya Koi Nai
<<DIVIDER>>
Tenu Apni Aba Day Vich Ali Di Dhee Paleydi Rai
Sadda Manhoos Nazran Ton Tenu Zainab Bachendi Rai
Teray Sadmay Ch Rondi Ay Ounday Sir Tey Rida Koi Nai
<<DIVIDER>>
Shareeyat Da Thakaza Ay Puttar Koi Jay Mar Jaway
Odi Maiyyat Nu Sab Chawan Magar Maiyyat Na Piu Chaway
Kera Chaway Tenu Akber Mera Apna Reya Koi Nai
<<DIVIDER>>
Shabi e Mustafa Tu Hain Sammar Meri Duawan Da
Sakoon e dil Ay Tu Akbar Sabhi Phuppiyan Tey Maawan Da
May Teray Kol Kinjh Aawan Nazar Anda Hay Raah Koi Nai
<<DIVIDER>>
Shaheed e Karbala Da Ghum Bari Tauqeer Wala Ay
Hadeesan Naal Sabit Ay Kitaban Vich Hawala Ay
Ay Matam Oh Ibaadat Ay Jidi Jag Tey Kazza Koi Nai
